items.stem: In supervised learning, the training error is usually ____ the test error.

options.rationale: Correct: models typically fit the training data better than unseen test data.
They are rarely exactly equal; a gap usually exists.
They are related; the gap reflects generalization.
Training error is generally the smaller of the two.

items.stem: A generalized linear model (GLM) generalizes ordinary linear regression by introducing:

options.text: A link function and a response distribution from the exponential family
options.rationale: Correct: GLMs use a link function and an exponential-family response.

options.text: A requirement that all predictors be categorical
options.rationale: GLM predictors can be continuous or categorical.

options.text: The removal of the intercept term
A ban on using a Gaussian response
options.rationale: Gaussian response is a valid special case of a GLM.

items.explanation: Correct: GLMs use a link function and an exponential-family response.

Correct: cross-validation estimates out-of-sample performance to control complexity.
